title: Letter
statementMd:
A boy Bob likes to draw. Not long ago he bought a rectangular graph (checked) sheet with $*n*$ rows and $*m*$ columns. Bob shaded some of the squares on the sheet. Having seen his masterpiece, he decided to share it with his elder brother, who lives in Flatland. Now Bob has to send his picture by post, but because of the world economic crisis and high oil prices, he wants to send his creation, but to spend as little money as possible. For each sent square of paper (no matter whether it is shaded or not) Bob has to pay 3.14 burles. Please, help Bob cut out of his masterpiece a rectangle of the minimum cost, that will contain all the shaded squares. The rectangle's sides should be parallel to the sheet's sides.

## Input

The first line of the input data contains numbers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 50$), $*n*$ — amount of lines, and $*m*$ — amount of columns on Bob's sheet. The following $*n*$ lines contain $*m*$ characters each. Character «`.`» stands for a non-shaded square on the sheet, and «`*`» — for a shaded square. It is guaranteed that Bob has shaded at least one square.

## Output

Output the required rectangle of the minimum cost. Study the output data in the sample tests to understand the output format better.
statementZhMd:
一个名叫 Bob 的男孩喜欢画画。不久前，他买了一张有 $*n*$ 行、$*m*$ 列的矩形方格纸。Bob 在纸上涂黑了一些方格。看到自己的杰作后，他决定与住在平面国的哥哥分享。现在 Bob 必须通过邮寄的方式寄出这幅画，但由于全球经济危机和高昂的油价，他希望寄出作品的同时尽可能少花钱。每寄出一格纸（无论该格是否被涂黑），Bob 都需要支付 3.14 布尔。请帮助 Bob 从他的作品中剪出一个费用最少的矩形，使其包含所有被涂黑的方格。矩形的边必须与方格纸的边平行。

## 输入格式

输入数据的第一行包含两个数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 50$），其中 $*n*$ 表示 Bob 的纸张行数，$*m*$ 表示列数。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含 $*m*$ 个字符。字符 «`.`» 表示纸上的未涂黑方格，字符 «`*`» 表示涂黑方格。保证 Bob 至少涂黑了一个方格。

## 输出格式

输出费用最少的所需矩形。请研究样例测试中的输出数据，以更好地理解输出格式。
